description: This file defines a utility function 'createWsClient' that creates a WebSocket client instance with event handling capabilities, based on feature flags and environment variables. It manages WebSocket connection setup and message/event handling.

methods.name: createWsClient(path = '/ws')
methods.description: Creates and returns a WebSocket client object with methods to attach event handlers, send messages, and close the connection. It respects feature flags and environment variables to determine whether to initiate a real WebSocket connection or a noop fallback.
